svg.title: AREA 05
svg.desc: Ignore enemies in the second room; pass the north false wall to warp 1. Hold the right blue pad for a teammate, then coordinate the switch by the door for the boxes. The collector presses green, then pink near the entrance to let the others through. Ignore enemies here; pass the north false wall and take 1→1′. Hold right blue for one player to cross; then coordinate the switch by the door to collect the boxes. Collector: press green, then pink by the entrance to release the waiting players.
